raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`can_use_linear_gelu` runs at every quality-gated GELU up-projection: FLUX, Qwen-Image, LongCat, LTX-2, HunyuanVideo, GLM-Image and Wan. On every call it re-ran the input-independent guards:
- the SM120 architecture check;
- the quantization, `skip_bias_add` and `gather_output` checks;
- the bias, weight rank and dtype checks.

That is 2.67 µs per call on an x86 host, mostly `getattr` misses on `nn.Module`. In a py-spy profile of FLUX.1 TP2 it was 1.3% of the denoise host time.

## Modifications

In `fused_linear_gelu_site.py`:
- The input-independent verdict is kept per linear in a `WeakKeyDictionary`.
- `mount_fused_linear_gelu` and `unmount_fused_linear_gelu` clear it, so a re-mount re-reads the linear.
- The per-input checks still run on every call: device, half dtype and `x.dtype == weight.dtype`.

No model call site changes. No memory is involved.

## Accuracy Tests

On H200:
- `test_sites.py`: 25 passed, including the new `test_linear_gelu_verdict_is_reused_until_remount`. It checks that three calls read the linear once and that a re-mount reads it again.
- `test_wan_gelu_mlp.py`: passed.
- `test_model_fast_paths.py`: 114 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Base `c15edf314d`, torch 2.14.1, H200 (Xeon 8558P).

| | µs per call |
|---|---|
| `can_use_linear_gelu` before | 2.67 |
| `can_use_linear_gelu` after | 0.75 |

**End to end**, FLUX.1-dev TP2 eager on 2xH200, client wall-clock median. Both paths were built into one server and chosen per request, rotating in the same process, with #44251 applied to both. An extra base arm measures in-process noise.

| | vs base | faster than base in | in-process A/A |
|---|---|---|---|
| FLUX.1-dev 512² | −0.92% | 11/12 | +0.33% (3/12) |
| FLUX.1-dev 1024² (GPU-bound) | +0.1% | 1/5 | +0.0% |

Output images are unchanged: the same path is chosen.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import logging
+import weakref
 from typing import Any
 
 import torch
@@ -128,20 +129,32 @@ def can_use_linear_gelu_static(linear: Any) -> bool:
     return _static_reject_reason(linear) is None
 
 
-def can_use_linear_gelu(linear: Any, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
-    """Whether ``gelu(linear(x))`` can use the fused cublasLt epilogue now."""
-    if not (x.is_cuda and x.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)):
-        return False
+# Input-independent verdict per linear, computed on first use; mounting and
+# unmounting clear it so a re-mount re-reads the linear.
+_VERDICTS: weakref.WeakKeyDictionary = weakref.WeakKeyDictionary()
+
+
+def _input_independent_ok(linear: Any) -> bool:
     arch = get_jit_cuda_arch()
     if arch.major * 10 + arch.minor >= 120:
         # The cublasLt GELU epilogue selected by current SM120 PyTorch/CUDA
         # builds is slower than GEMM + the native GELU kernel for the FLUX
         # production shape (1, 512, 3072 -> 12288).  Keep quality-gated sites
         # on their existing eager path on RTX 5090; SM90 dispatch is unchanged.
         return False
+    return can_use_linear_gelu_static(linear)
+
+
+def can_use_linear_gelu(linear: Any, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``gelu(linear(x))`` can use the fused cublasLt epilogue now."""
+    if not (x.is_cuda and x.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)):
+        return False
     if getattr(linear, "weight", None) is None or x.dtype != linear.weight.dtype:
         return False
-    return can_use_linear_gelu_static(linear)
+    verdict = _VERDICTS.get(linear)
+    if verdict is None:
+        verdict = _VERDICTS[linear] = _input_independent_ok(linear)
+    return verdict
 
 
 def mark_fused_gelu_site(module: nn.Module, linear_attr: str) -> None:
@@ -172,9 +185,11 @@ def mount_fused_linear_gelu(root: nn.Module) -> bool:
     left (or reset) on the reference path and False is returned. Returns False
     as well when ``root`` has no marked sites.
     """
+    _VERDICTS.clear()
     return _FUSION.mount(root, reject_reason=_site_reject_reason, logger=logger)
 
 
 def unmount_fused_linear_gelu(root: nn.Module) -> None:
     """Reset every marked site under ``root`` to the bit-exact reference path."""
+    _VERDICTS.clear()
     _FUSION.unmount(root)

@@ -433,6 +433,31 @@ def test_fused_linear_gelu_guards_and_lossless_path():
     assert not linear_gelu.can_use_linear_gelu(good.proj, x.float())
 
 
+@requires_cuda
+def test_linear_gelu_verdict_is_reused_until_remount(monkeypatch):
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability() >= (12, 0):
+        pytest.skip(
+            "SM120 keeps these sites on the eager path before reading the linear"
+        )
+    site = _GeluSite()
+    x = torch.randn(16, 64, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    assert linear_gelu.mount_fused_linear_gelu(site)
+    reads = []
+    static = linear_gelu.can_use_linear_gelu_static
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        linear_gelu,
+        "can_use_linear_gelu_static",
+        lambda linear: reads.append(linear) or static(linear),
+    )
+    for _ in range(3):
+        assert linear_gelu.can_use_linear_gelu(site.proj, x)
+    assert reads == [site.proj]
+    linear_gelu.unmount_fused_linear_gelu(site)
+    assert linear_gelu.mount_fused_linear_gelu(site)
+    assert linear_gelu.can_use_linear_gelu(site.proj, x)
+    assert reads == [site.proj, site.proj]
+
